parse_sse_events: parse SSE data lines from an Anthropic or OpenAI streaming response into a list of JSON objects
normalize_entry: normalize a trace entry with a raw_response string into a structured response dict with content and usage
canonicalize_entry: canonicalize a trace entry by attaching provider-neutral request messages and response blocks for the viewer
load_llm_calls: load all llm_call entries from a trace.jsonl file and return them as a list of dicts
extract_provider: infer the LLM provider from trace entries by checking URL patterns and response structure heuristics
